title: Recording: Rock Show by Wings | 1974
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Mark Vigars

Wings resumed the recording of the Venus And Mars song ‘Rock Show’ on 14 November 1974.

They had worked on the song over two sessions earlier in the month, but the results were deemed insufficient. They returned to it over this and the following day, finally completing a satisfactory recording.

Guesting in this session was percussionist Kenneth ‘Afro’ Williams from funk band Chocolate Milk. He was invited to play on the song by Paul McCartney, adding congas to each of the day’s six takes.

However, none of the takes, all but one of which were complete, were considered good enough, and Wings parked the song until the following day.
